description: File to base64 and back. Encode a file as base64 — to paste an image straight into CSS, say — or decode a base64 string back into a file. The direction is worked out for you. Accepts */*; up to 20 MB per file.

dataUri.description: Wrap in data:… so the string can go straight into CSS or HTML

lineBreaks.description: Wrap lines every 76 characters, the way email does

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

name: utility_base64
